name: cache-context-usage
description: A one-line bar above the Claude Code prompt: cache │ context │ usage. Each word turns green, yellow or red (usage: your plan's weekly limit against how far through the week you are, cyan when you have spare to spend before it resets); click a word for its details.

style.title: How the clock shows
style.description: tray (the default): the words cache, context and usage at the right of the line, each opening its details when clicked; a red item opens by itself. full: the whole line all the time, as the original cache-clock. CACHE_CLOCK_STYLE overrides it.

onWarning.title: When the cache is about to go cold
onWarning.description: What to do at the warning if you haven't replied. off (the default here): just the toast. handoff: Claude writes a per-session HANDOFF-<id>.md in the project root.
